title: [tenmin-daily-liquid] tenMinDailyRedispatchHold: characterization test for empty, upper-case and unrelated values
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for tenMinDailyRedispatchHold in src/tenmin-daily-liquid.ts: redispatch hold values
- tenMinDailyRedispatchHold({ TENMIN_AUTO_REDISPATCH: "" }) is 'SKIP_REDISPATCH_PAUSED:TENMIN_AUTO_REDISPATCH=""'
- tenMinDailyRedispatchHold({ TENMIN_AUTO_REDISPATCH: "TRUE" }) is 'SKIP_REDISPATCH_PAUSED:TENMIN_AUTO_REDISPATCH="TRUE"'
- tenMinDailyRedispatchHold({ TENMIN_AUTO_REDISPATCH: "true", TENMIN_DAILY_ENABLED: "false" }) is undefined
- tenMinDailyRedispatchHold({ TENMIN_DAILY_ENABLED: "true" }) is "SKIP_REDISPATCH_PAUSED:TENMIN_AUTO_REDISPATCH=unset"

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v6): Peace's task (source: peace). tenMinDailyRedispatchHold is tested with unset, "false" and "true"; an empty value, "TRUE", and other env keys next to or without TENMIN_AUTO_REDISPATCH are untested; this pins them. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. File only after public-test-case-existing-v6 is approved (#464). A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 0ab37c8 (Workspace main 1fbe917 with a local-only simulated v6 approval, Node 22) built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v6); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with tenMinDailyRedispatchHold stubbed); suite 614/614 with all sixteen new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok. Disjoint file: each task in this batch creates its own new test file. Expected COUNTS.)
